sources.A: Brief SOURCES Row A: official Hermitage EN, archived 2018; 800 m², two window tiers, double Corinthian columns; original interior.
sources.ANGLES: Brief SEEN-FROM-RAIL: pinned binary64 cosine/tangent literals.
sources.B: Brief SOURCES Row B: ru.wikipedia, Георгиевский (Большой тронный) зал Зимнего дворца; approximately 800 m², paired wall columns.
sources.BUDGET: DECISION-1 CONTRACT, BUDGET ROW and P7; estimates, not asset measurements.
sources.C: Brief SOURCES Row C: post-1837 Stasov restoration; white Carrara marble walls and columns; official museum corroboration.
sources.D: Brief SOURCES Row D: sixteen woods; parquet repeats ceiling divisions and ornament, except state symbols.
sources.DESIGN: DECISION-1 adopted design: L 47, W 17, 48 design columns; not historical measurements or a historically confirmed column count.
sources.DETAIL: Step-1 implementation design choices under DECISION-1 SHAPE: stylised capitals, neutral shell, plates, two reserved heroes; ratios and tessellation are artistic construction, not historical evidence.
sources.E: Brief SOURCES Row E: marble Saint George and dragon relief above throne.
sources.F: Brief SOURCES Row F: Ukhtomsky, Георгиевский зал, 1862; observed gilt multi-tier chandeliers along axis; total count not established.
sources.FRAME: DECISION-1 FRAME and Amendments; rooms/1812/contract.ts lines 9–14, 29–30, 45, 93–98; X0 91, axis 14.5, floor 10, eye 11.65.
sources.G: Brief SOURCES Row G: crimson canopy and stepped throne dais.
sources.H: Brief SOURCES Row H: double-headed eagle observed in 1862 watercolour and 2015 photograph; observed, not text-confirmed.
sources.I: Brief SOURCES Row I: long-wall balcony galleries observed in primary visuals.
sources.J: Brief SOURCES Row J: east palace block; west approach, east throne inferred from text and plans and fixed in-world by committed doors.
sources.K: Brief SOURCES Row K: Stasov white-marble interior, throne restored by 2000.
sources.L: Brief SOURCES (observed): К. А. Ухтомский, «Виды залов Зимнего дворца. Георгиевский зал», 1862 watercolour — the restored hall as built: Corinthian capitals on the paired columns (row F shares this source).
sources.RAIL: DECISION-1 CONTRACT and re-anchored brief FRAME: H0–H4 and subjects.
